theme.en: AI Chip Scrutiny Spreads Across the Supply Chain
theme.zh: AI芯片监管审查延伸至整条供应链

dek.en: Investigations in Malaysia and Singapore and U.S. criticism of export-control enforcement put AI-chip distribution under closer scrutiny. GlobalFoundries' $10 billion groundbreaking and HPE's response to rising SSD costs show how manufacturing investment and memory economics shape hardware decisions.
dek.zh: 马来西亚与新加坡推进调查，美国官员质疑出口管制执行，AI芯片分销链条面临更严格的审查。格芯100亿美元项目动工，以及HPE应对SSD成本上涨的举措，则体现了制造投资与存储成本对硬件决策的影响。

title.en: Forensic Report Links Chinese AI Models to Nvidia Blackwell Training
title.zh: 取证报告称中国AI模型具有使用Nvidia Blackwell训练的特征

summary.en: A former OpenAI engineer's forensic report identifies what it describes as Blackwell fingerprints in models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group, The Register reports. The findings raise questions about how Chinese AI developers access export-restricted training hardware and add a technical line of inquiry to scrutiny of chip distribution.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，一名前OpenAI工程师的取证报告称，在DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、MiniMax和蚂蚁集团的模型中识别到Blackwell训练特征。这些发现引出中国AI开发者如何获取受出口限制训练硬件的问题，也为芯片分销审查增加了技术调查线索。

title.en: GlobalFoundries Breaks Ground on $10 Billion New York Facility
title.zh: 格芯纽约州100亿美元半导体制造项目动工

summary.en: GlobalFoundries breaks ground on a new $10 billion semiconductor manufacturing facility in Saratoga County, New York, according to Empire State Development. The construction milestone advances a major U.S. manufacturing investment and brings the project's execution into focus for the regional semiconductor supply chain.
summary.zh: 据纽约州帝国发展署消息，格芯位于纽约州萨拉托加县、投资100亿美元的新半导体制造项目动工。开工推动了这项美国大型制造投资的落地，项目后续建设进度也将成为当地半导体供应链的关注重点。

title.en: TSMC Confirms Employee Data Leak as Sellers Offer 46,000 Records
title.zh: 台积电确认员工数据外泄，卖家兜售46000条记录

summary.en: TSMC confirms an employee data leak as hackers seek Bitcoin payments for 46,000 records, CryptoPotato reports. The incident puts employee-information handling and exposure to follow-on identity abuse in focus at a major foundry supplier.
summary.zh: 据CryptoPotato报道，台积电确认员工数据外泄，黑客正以Bitcoin计价兜售46000条记录。这起事件使这家大型晶圆代工企业的员工信息管理，以及数据被进一步用于身份冒用的风险受到关注。

title.en: UC Riverside Work Moves HBM4 Controller Functions Closer to Memory
title.zh: 加州大学河滨分校研究将HBM4控制器功能向存储端迁移

summary.en: UC Riverside research covered by Semiconductor Engineering explores shifting HBM4 controller functions closer to memory. The approach makes the placement of control logic a design consideration for accelerator-memory co-design as engineers develop HBM4 systems.
summary.zh: Semiconductor Engineering介绍了加州大学河滨分校的一项研究，探索将HBM4控制器的部分功能向存储端迁移。随着HBM4系统开发推进，这一思路使控制逻辑的部署位置成为加速器与存储器协同设计中的一个考量。

title.en: HPE Introduces Hybrid HPC Storage as SSD Costs Rise
title.zh: SSD成本上涨，HPE推出混合式高性能计算存储配置

summary.en: HPE introduces hybrid storage configurations for high-performance computing as rising SSD costs affect supercomputing budgets, The Register reports. The offering targets storage performance and cost efficiency, linking flash-memory economics directly to system configuration decisions.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，SSD成本上涨影响超级计算预算，HPE为高性能计算推出混合式存储配置。这些配置着眼于存储性能与成本效率，使闪存成本变化直接进入系统配置决策。

title.en: Malaysia and Singapore Escalate Nvidia Hardware Investigations
title.zh: 马来西亚与新加坡推进Nvidia硬件调查

summary.en: Malaysia investigates possible re-exports of Nvidia AI hardware, while Singapore charges an executive over suspicious purchases of 917 AI servers, Tom's Hardware reports. The cases put regional procurement and re-export channels at the center of enforcement concerns surrounding U.S. restrictions on China.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，马来西亚调查Nvidia AI硬件可能被转口出口的问题，新加坡则因涉及917台AI服务器的可疑采购起诉一名高管。这些案件使区域采购与转口渠道成为美国对华限制措施执行中的关注重点。

title.en: Bessent Criticizes Commerce Over Controls on Nvidia Partner Megaspeed
title.zh: Bessent批评美国商务部对Nvidia合作伙伴Megaspeed的出口管制措施

summary.en: Bessent blames the U.S. Commerce Department for a lack of export controls on Nvidia partner Megaspeed, Reuters reports. The criticism increases political pressure on the department's handling of AI-chip distribution and the intermediaries involved in overseas sales.
summary.zh: 据路透社报道，Bessent指责美国商务部对Nvidia合作伙伴Megaspeed缺乏出口管制措施。这一批评加大了政治压力，使商务部对AI芯片分销及海外销售中间商的监管处理受到更多关注。

title.en: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Semiconductor Innovation Fund Grant
title.zh: 得克萨斯理工大学获1900万美元半导体创新基金资助

summary.en: Texas Tech receives a $19 million grant from the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund, the Lubbock Avalanche-Journal reports. The award directs state semiconductor funding into a university and adds to the resources supporting Texas's semiconductor innovation ecosystem.
summary.zh: 据Lubbock Avalanche-Journal报道，得克萨斯理工大学获得得克萨斯州半导体创新基金1900万美元资助。这笔拨款将州级半导体资金投入高校，为当地半导体创新生态增添资源。

title.en: Taiwan Semiconductor Output Value Reaches Record NT$9.76 Trillion
title.zh: 台湾半导体产值达新台币9.76万亿元，创历史新高

summary.en: Taiwan's semiconductor output value reaches a record NT$9.76 trillion, with memory output value at 2.6 times its comparison level and foundry output value exceeding NT$6 trillion for the first time, BigGo Finance reports. The figures place memory's expansion alongside the foundry sector's scale as drivers of the island's semiconductor production value.
summary.zh: 据BigGo Finance报道，台湾半导体产值创下新台币9.76万亿元纪录，存储器产值达到比较基期的2.6倍，晶圆代工产值首次突破新台币6万亿元。这组数据体现了存储器业务扩张与晶圆代工规模对台湾半导体产值的共同拉动。

title.en: Cerebras Prepares CS-5 for 2027 as Another Hyperscaler Signs On
title.zh: Cerebras筹备2027年推出CS-5，并获另一家超大规模云厂商客户

summary.en: Cerebras prepares its CS-5 systems for a 2027 launch while securing another hyperscale customer, The Next Platform reports. The roadmap update links its next system generation to an expanding cloud-customer base, giving AI infrastructure buyers a schedule to assess in future accelerator procurement.
summary.zh: 据The Next Platform报道，Cerebras正筹备于2027年推出CS-5系统，同时获得另一家超大规模云厂商客户。这一路线图进展将其下一代系统与扩大的云客户群联系起来，为AI基础设施买方评估未来加速器采购提供了时间参考。
